use_case.name: Manufacturing Knowledge Base RAG Assistant
use_case.description: Role-aware question-answering assistant that retrieves cited answers from internal manufacturing policies, equipment manuals, and management documents, with pre-retrieval RBAC to enforce document access boundaries.

business_spec.current_process: Employees manually search internal policies, equipment manuals, and management documents to find answers; the process is slow and may result in incomplete or unsupported responses.
pain_points: Employees may miss the most relevant or applicable source
No enforcement of document access controls during informal searches
Answers are not traceable to a verified source
business_spec.proposed_solution: A RAG-based assistant that accepts natural-language questions, applies pre-retrieval RBAC based on the requestor role, retrieves semantically relevant chunks from allowed documents only, and generates cited answers in a structured RAGAnswerRecord format.
target_outputs: RAGAnswerRecord JSON list (query_id, role, question, access_decision, answer, citations, refusal_reason)
success_criteria: Q01 (employee, Helsinki hotel limit): answers EUR 180 per night with Finance Director approval required when exceeded, citing [employee_travel_policy.pdf, 3]
Q02 (employee, MX-200 filter): answers inspection every 250 operating hours and replacement after 1,000 operating hours or 1.8 bar, citing mx200_maintenance_manual.pdf pages 3 and 4
Q03 (employee, Project Aurora ceiling): access_decision=denied, empty citations list, no restricted facts disclosed
Q04 (manager, Project Aurora ceiling and approver): answers 12 percent ceiling with written CFO approval required above the ceiling, citing [project_aurora_pricing_strategy.pdf, 3]
All four results returned as separate non-empty parseable JSON objects in output/results.json
expected_value: Every factual answer is traceable to a verified source via citations
Restricted documents are never disclosed to unauthorized roles
Reduced risk of incomplete or unsupported answers
risks: Hallucinated or speculative answers not grounded in retrieved content
Unauthorized chunk leakage into model context via pre-filter bypass
Restricted facts disclosed in answer text on a denied query
Answer returned when no authorized source supports the claim
business_spec.poc_goal: Demonstrate role-aware, citation-grounded question answering over three PDF documents using a local vector store and trusted role metadata. CLI: python run_poc.py --input <path-to-poc_input_bundle.json>. Execute all four role-tagged queries (Q01-Q04) and save non-empty parseable JSON results to output/results.json.

data_sources: local file bundle resolved relative to poc_input_bundle.json at runtime
security_constraints: RBAC pre-filter: role from trusted request metadata (not inferred from question); access_manifest.json maps documents to allowed_roles; unauthorized chunks must never enter model context
Cloud LLM API calls to Azure OpenAI are permitted
No personal data in synthetic PoC fixtures
No audit-log service required for PoC; enterprise identity integration is out of PoC scope

field_descriptions.role: Requestor role from trusted request metadata; must not be inferred from question content
field_descriptions.question: The natural-language question as supplied in query_set.json
field_descriptions.access_decision: allowed if the role has access to documents that answer the query; denied otherwise
field_descriptions.answer: Cited factual answer grounded only in retrieved content; refusal message when access_decision=denied
field_descriptions.citations: List of [file_name, page_number] pairs (1-based integer); empty list when access_decision=denied
field_descriptions.refusal_reason: Required (non-null) when access_decision=denied; must not reveal restricted facts; null otherwise

target_output_spec.missing_value_policy: If authorized sources do not support an answer, state the information was not found and do not speculate. Do not fabricate citations.
validation_rules: citations must be an empty list when access_decision=denied
refusal_reason must be non-null when access_decision=denied
each citation must be exactly [str, int] (filename, 1-based page number)
answer must not reveal restricted content when access_decision=denied
allowed factual answers must include at least one citation to a document permitted for that role
exact values must be preserved: EUR 180, 250 operating hours, 1,000 operating hours, 1.8 bar, 12 percent, 22 percent

assumptions.text: A local in-memory vector store (numpy cosine similarity or equivalent) is used for the PoC instead of PostgreSQL+pgvector, as the user explicitly requested a local vector store. The standard RAGWorkflow module is not selected.

The knowledge_owner role is treated as having the same document access as manager (all three documents). The user specified employee and manager access tiers; knowledge_owner was described functionally but not mapped to an access tier.
Structure-aware chunking uses paragraph or section boundaries with moderate overlap (approximately 10-20% of chunk size). Exact chunk size defaults to approximately 512 tokens.
The Azure OpenAI embedding deployment name is provided via environment variable AZURE_EMBEDDING_DEPLOYMENT. The specific model name is not user-confirmed.

RBAC pre-filtering reads allowed_roles from access_manifest.json at index time, attaches them as chunk metadata, and filters the candidate pool to role-permitted chunks before any similarity search. The role value is taken from the query request metadata and trusted as-is.

BPMN swimlane structure: Requestor lane (employee or manager submits query via CLI), GAIK AI System lane (ingests, filters, retrieves, generates), Knowledge Owner shown as a collapsed pool (document maintenance, out of PoC scope). Not specified by the user.

Denied-query exception path terminates with a clean 'Access Denied' end event and returns the denied RAGAnswerRecord to the caller. No additional notification, escalation, or logging step is modelled. Not specified by the user.
